course_name_en: Basic Communication Systems Design and Application

learning_outcomes.text: Learns the fundamentals of digital communication.
Obtains knowledge about digital baseband transmission.
Obtains knowledge about digital transmission over band-limited channels and pulse shaping.
Obtains knowledge about equalization and synchronization.
Obtains knowledge about binary digital modulation techniques.
Obtains knowledge about multi-level digital modulation techniques.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Digital Communication, Pulse Modulation, Sampling and PCM
Introduction to Digital Baseband Transmission and Line Coding
Characteristics of Band-Limited Channels and Pulse Shaping
Orthogonal Functions and Binary Digital Modulations (BASK)
Multi-Level Digital Modulations (QAM, QPSK and OQPSK)
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
